findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Employees were observed donning gloves without handwashing. Education was carried out. The behavior was abolished. Ensure that adequate handwashing procedures are followed before donning gloves in between tasks.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The hand sink in the meat cutting room was observed cluttered with brushes and scrubs. Education was provided. An employee removed the items from the hand sink to render it accessible. Ensure that all hand sinks within the facility are available and accessible at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: REPEAT The quaternary ammonia sanitizer in the bucket by the counter of the meat department was observed reading between 100-0 ppm. Discussed with the PIC and a sani bucket was remade. Ensure that the concentration of the sanitizer is monitored and tested at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(E) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (E) If a chemical SANITIZER other than chlorine, iodine, or a quaternary ammonium compound is used, it shall be applied in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: There were an assortment of cardboard boxes of food items stored directly on the floor in the back for dry storage. Discussed with the PIC. The PIC assured inspector that the boxes will be removed from the floor. Ensure that food items are stored at least 6-inches above the floor to protect them from splash, dust, and other contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed dirty mop water sitting in the bucket in the janitorial cage area in the back. Discussed with the PIC. The waster was discarded. Ensure that employees are aware to always discard the mop water after use.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.15 Cleaning Maintenance Tools, Preventing Contamination. FOOD preparation sinks, HANDWASHING SINKS, and WAREWASHING EQUIPMENT may not be used for the cleaning of maintenance tools, the preparation or holding of maintenance materials, or the disposal of mop water and similar liquid wastes.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed no sani bucket in the produce prep room during food prep. Discussed with PIC and a sani bucket was made to have this violation corrected. Ensure that a sani bucket is available during food prep at all times.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(E) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: There was no sanitizer available during the cut-fruit prep in the produce prep room. PIC was made aware that a sanitizer bucket needs to be available during food prep at all times. A sanitizer bucket was made to correct this violation. Ensure that a sanitizer is prepared during food prep at all times. A follow-up is set for 04/25/2025.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The accumulation of Ice behind the fan and on the floor in the walk in freezers in the back storage area. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that the ice will be cleaned up. Ensure that the the ice is removed to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.16(B) Wall and Ceiling Coverings and Coatings. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The accumulation of soils and food items were observed under shelves. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured that the accumulation of soils and food items will be cleaned during their inventory inspection. Ensure that shelves in the facility is monitored and cleaned at a regular frequency to prevent the accumulation of soil and food items under shelves for a prolonged period of time .
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

Complaint is valid. Milk debris and visible black mold on the milk shelving units in front where customers reach-in. Shelving units should be cleaned - wash, rinse, sanitize. Pressure wash the shelves.

Inspector will follow-up on 12/7/23.

*Phone: 217-891-3012 Alexis Scherba*
Call when cleaning is done (before 12/7/23).

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Employees in the meat department were observed to not have their food handler training. Ensure that any employee that handles food or food equipment has completed the Food Handlers training course.
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
The hot water fixture on the hand sink in the meat cutting room was in disrepair and unable to be used. PIC was putting in a service call to get the issue repaired.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Floors in the Frozen deli, seafood, walk in freezer was soiled with large debris. Clean floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Gasket on the ice machine lid in the back seafood room was peeling off. Repair or replace gasket.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Three compartment sink in the meat room was separating from the wall. Seal sink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: 1)Observed no thermometer at first reach in open cooler for sale meat. Employee provided a thermometer for cooler to CORRECT the violation. 2)Observed no thermometer in reach in freezer holding Jack's pizzas. Provide a thermometer for freezer.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
1) Meatballs were uncovered in walk in meat cooler. Cover food at all times. 2)Cottage cheese was on floor of walk in dairy cooler. Store food 6 inches or higher off the floor. 
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
White paper used to catch food debris in reach in milk cooler is soiled with food debris. Material needs to be changed daily.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
Observed no hot water from produce handwashing sink. Provide hot water.
750-820 For manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing utensils and equipment, each compartment of the sink shall be supplied with hot and cold potable running water.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Hand sink in meat room walk in cooler was blocked by boxes. Boxes were moved to CORRECT the violation.
750-1120(b) Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Floor underneath prep sink area in meat department is soiled with food debris. Clean floor.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Rolls were stored below raw fish in the frozen deli walk-in cooler.  The rolls were moved to a top shelf above the fish to CORRECT the violation.
.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
The top inside of the microwave in the deli area dining area was soiled. (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Clean and sanitize the inside of the microwave.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:
  1.  mop sink in the maintenance station
  2.  dairy display case - bottom front inside of case
  3.  inside of breading table in seafood area (REPEAT VIOLATION)
  4.  produce green rack (cooler) - bottom front inside of case
  5.  inside cabinet under dining area handsink (REPEAT VIOLATION)
Clean these surfaces.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
A faucet on the handsink in the women's restroom (customer area) did not work.  Repair the faucet.

750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1.  The floor of the frozen foods walk-in cooler was soiled just inside the door.  Clean the floor.
2.  There was a gap under the coving in the meat cutting room allowing food to gather under the coving.  Seal the coving to the floor.
3.  The coving in the produce walk-in cooler was coming loose.  Re-attach the coving to the wall and floor.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1.  The mop sink on the floor in the maintenance station is moldy where it is attached to the wall.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Remove the old caulk and re-seal the gap.
2.  The walls around the mop sink (one on the floor) are soiled.  Clean the walls.
3.  The 3-pan sink in the meat cutting room is developing a gap in the caulk seal where it attaches to the wall.  Re-caulk the junction.
4.  The ceiling is coming apart above the 3-pan sink and above the door to the produce cooler in the produce prep room.  Repair the ceiling and replace all missing ceiling panels.

750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
There were burnt out light bulbs in the following locations:
  1.  frozen food walk-in cooler ceiling
  2.  vent hood over the fryers in the seafood area.
Replace the bulbs.

750-1230(a) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide at least 20 foot-candles of light on all food preparation surfaces and at equipment or utensil washing areas.
750-1230(b)(2) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide, at a distance of 30 inches from the floor at least 10 foot-candles of light in walk-in refrigeration, dry storage areas, and in all other areas.
